scope.objective: Track reproducible community reports about public camera IDs, GCam behavior, stock lens switching, firmware regressions and stock-camera features, then convert the reports into controlled device tests.
scope.interpretationRule: Community reports are leads or corroborated observations, never implementation proof. Claims enter capability or routing specifications only after controlled target-device evidence.
scope.redistributionRule: Do not redistribute camera APKs, GCam packages, private logs or user photographs. Preserve source links, bounded summaries and test protocols only.

evidenceGrades.SECOND_HAND_LEAD: A report repeats a tool/app notification or another person's claim without testing on the device.
evidenceGrades.SINGLE_REPORT: One device owner reports a behavior with insufficient independent confirmation.
evidenceGrades.MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_REPORTS: Two or more distinct participants report materially similar behavior, but the reports remain uncontrolled.
evidenceGrades.OFFICIAL_CONTEXT_PLUS_REPORT: An official changelog establishes build context and a community participant reports behavior on that release.

buildContext.value: Post-NOS 3.2/4.0 period; exact build not recorded by every participant

limitations: Preview/final comparisons are user-supplied and not calibrated.
Beauty settings were reportedly disabled, but no settings export or metadata is available.

reports.reportedBehavior: A GCamator notification identified Nothing A001 as compatible with a GCam 8.4 build.
limitations: The reporting participant did not own the phone and did not install the app.
Compatibility may mean installation or main-camera operation only.

reports.reportedBehavior: One participant reported Camera2 API hardware level 3 and only one rear camera listed by Camera2 API Probe.
limitations: Probe version, package identity, complete export and firmware build were not supplied.
A probe UI count does not prove that no hidden, system-only or logical physical routes exist.

reports.reportedBehavior: At 1080p30, the reporter could select and switch among 0.6x, 1x and 2x while recording, with smooth handover.
limitations: Physical sensor activation was inferred from UI labels rather than synchronized metadata or sensor traces.
The exact build and camera package version were not recorded.

reports.reportedBehavior: The same reporter described no telephoto selection or handover at 1080p60, and fixed preselected 1x or 2x routes during 4K30 recording.
limitations: The assertion that zoom remained digital was not backed by focal-length metadata in the post.
A disabled UI control does not identify whether the restriction is camera policy, stream compatibility, thermal policy or stabilization.

reports.reportedBehavior: Multiple participants associated V3.2-251103-2121 with less natural HDR, darker or overprocessed output, skin-tone changes, low-light degradation, highlight clipping and slower capture processing.
limitations: Reports were made under uncontrolled scenes and do not all separate auto HDR, scene detection, front/rear camera or mode.
Independent agreement raises priority but does not establish a single root cause.

reports.reportedBehavior: Participants described a visible 1x-to-2x shift/glitch and differing main/tele processing after V3.2-251103-2121.
limitations: The reports do not distinguish optical handover from digital zoom threshold behavior.
No synchronized focal-length, physical-camera result or stock request trace is attached.

reports.reportedBehavior: The B4.1-260415-1710 changelog states overall camera stability improved, and one participant reported a prior video lens-switching glitch working well after the update.
limitations: The changelog does not identify the specific video issue.
One positive report cannot establish that every switching path or device was fixed.

reports.reportedBehavior: A participant reported focus oscillation after OS 4.0 that persisted on B4.1-260415-1710, with 0.6x and 2x focused at distance while 1x remained unfocused.
limitations: No focus-distance target, AF state log, lens cleanliness inspection or hardware diagnostic is provided.
A single device report cannot separate firmware, calibration, actuator or unit-specific faults.

reports.reportedBehavior: Multiple participants described final selfies as more smoothed, sharpened, HDR-heavy or less natural than the live preview even after beauty controls were reportedly disabled.
limitations: Display preview, saved JPEG and uploaded forum images use different rendering paths.
The reports do not isolate HDR, face retouching, tone mapping or display color management.

reports.reportedBehavior: One participant reported the phone sometimes shutting down and restarting after prolonged use of the stock camera app, but not during a quick single capture.
limitations: No tombstone, pstore, thermal trace, battery state or system log is available.
The report may describe an app crash, watchdog reset, thermal shutdown, power fault or unrelated reboot.

controlledTests.objective: Reproduce public camera enumeration on an exact build and retain the complete machine-readable result.
protocol: Record build fingerprint, stock camera version, probe package/version and test timestamp.
Enumerate CameraManager camera IDs as the replacement app and diagnostic app.
For each ID record hardware level, lens facing, focal lengths, logical/physical IDs, request/result/session keys and open result.
Repeat after reboot and compare with package-identity-controlled probes where permitted.
controlledTests.decisionRule: A public-ID claim is accepted only when two runs on the same exact build agree and the complete export is preserved. Hidden or system-only routes remain separate.

controlledTests.objective: Determine what one explicitly identified third-party camera build can install, open and route without redistributing it.
protocol: Record APK package name, version, signer digest and acquisition provenance without committing the APK.
Run main, ultrawide and telephoto UI selections at photo and supported video modes.
Record CameraService opens, Camera2 IDs, focal length, crop region, output EXIF and failures.
Repeat on the stock app as a same-build control.
controlledTests.decisionRule: Compatibility means only the exact tested operations. Installation or main-camera capture does not imply auxiliary-lens access.

controlledTests.objective: Measure stock route availability and in-recording handover by resolution and frame rate.
protocol: Test 1080p30, 1080p60 and 4K30 with 0.6x, 1x and 2x selected before recording.
Attempt each route transition while recording and record UI state, capture result focal length, crop, physical ID and sensor timestamp.
Repeat three times in controlled light and after thermal cooldown.
Record unsupported combinations separately from failed transitions.
requiredArtifacts: Screen recording or UI event log
controlledTests.decisionRule: A physical-lens route is confirmed only by correlated metadata or sensor evidence, not by zoom labels alone.

controlledTests.objective: Quantify visual and metadata discontinuity at stock lens handover thresholds.
protocol: Use a fixed tripod, locked scene, stable illumination and a color/geometry target.
Record slow zoom sweeps and discrete 1x/2x selections in supported modes.
Measure frame-to-frame field of view, white balance, exposure, focus, timestamp gaps and physical-route changes.
Compare across exact firmware builds when available.
controlledTests.decisionRule: A firmware regression requires a repeatable build-to-build increase in discontinuity under the same protocol.

controlledTests.objective: Test processing-regression reports across firmware builds without relying on memory or forum-compressed samples.
protocol: Use the same device, tripod, calibrated target, illumination and camera settings before and after an update where safe images are available.
Capture auto HDR on/off, front/rear, low-light and backlit scenes with RAW/JPEG where supported.
Record exposure, ISO, white balance, focal length, processing time and JPEG metadata.
Compare objective clipping, tone, color and sharpness metrics and retain originals privately.
controlledTests.decisionRule: A regression is recorded only when the controlled metric change is repeatable and not explained by exposure, mode, route or scene differences.

controlledTests.objective: Separate live-preview rendering from saved-image HDR, retouching and JPEG processing.
protocol: Capture a calibrated face/skin-tone chart and non-face control under fixed light.
Record preview frames and final JPEG/RAW with beauty, HDR and scene features toggled where available.
Log face-detection results, capture requests/results, exposure and processing latency.
Compare preview and final tone, texture, sharpness and color in a common color space.
controlledTests.decisionRule: A post-processing effect is attributed only after preview/display color differences and exposure changes are controlled.

controlledTests.objective: Determine whether reported focus oscillation is route-, build-, scene- or unit-specific.
protocol: Use near, mid and far high-contrast targets under measured illumination.
Test 0.6x, 1x and 2x with tap AF, continuous AF and repeated camera reopen.
Record AF mode/state, lens focus distance, actuator/result timing, sharpness and route metadata.
Repeat after reboot and compare with another device unit if available.
controlledTests.decisionRule: A firmware focus defect requires repeatability across sessions and separation from a single-unit actuator or calibration failure.

controlledTests.objective: Classify long-session camera crashes, reboots or thermal shutdowns.
protocol: Run a fixed sequence of preview, capture, video, mode switching and preset editing for a bounded duration.
Record temperature, memory, battery, CameraService state, logcat, tombstones, pstore and reboot reason.
Repeat from cool state and under a non-camera control workload.
Stop on unsafe temperature or repeated system instability.
controlledTests.decisionRule: Do not classify the cause without a matching crash, watchdog, thermal or power artifact.

nonClaims: A community report does not prove a Camera2 implementation, hidden API, vendor-tag meaning or privilege boundary.
One rear camera shown by a probe does not prove that auxiliary sensors are absent or physically inaccessible to the stock app.
A stock UI lens label does not prove which physical sensor produced a frame.
Independent reports increase test priority but do not establish a common root cause.
An official camera-stability changelog does not identify every fixed or remaining camera defect.
This register does not recommend or redistribute third-party camera packages.

updateTriggers: A report provides an exact build, camera package version or machine-readable probe export
Two independent reports corroborate or contradict an indexed behavior
A controlled test produces target-device evidence
A new firmware changes public IDs, lens routing, focus, processing or stability
